The 1 October Cut-Off

The new benefits apply only to employees whose job loss happened on or after 1 October 2026. The application date does not determine which rates apply.

50%Early Re-employment Allowance: percentage of remaining JSA
RM30/dayNew Training Allowance rate
RM7,000Maximum training fee
RM1,000Mobility Allowance for eligible claimants
  • Job loss on or before 30 September: old rates apply.
  • Job loss on or after 1 October: new benefits may apply, subject to eligibility.
HR tip: Check the employee's job loss date, not the date they submit their application.

RM1,000 Mobility Allowance

Eligible EIS contributors who lost their job on or after 1 October may apply if their new workplace is 100km or more from home and they have already started work.

  • Apply through the LINDUNG Kerjaya portal: lindungkerjaya.perkeso.gov.my.
  • Upload the new job offer letter or employment contract.
  • Upload confirmation from the new employer as proof that work has started.
  • Moving house is not required; the distance between home and the new workplace matters.
Employer role: Prepare offer letters and start-of-work confirmation documents so eligible new hires can support their claims.

Vacancy Notification

The amended law requires employers, including SMEs, to notify PERKESO in writing at two stages when hiring.

  • Before hiring: Notify PERKESO of the vacancy or new position in writing.
  • Within 7 days of filling the position: Notify PERKESO again in writing.
RM1,000Maximum fine for first offence
RM3,000Maximum fine for second offence
RM5,000Maximum fine for third or subsequent offence
Not yet in forceStart date to be announced officially
  • Fines shown are maximum fines upon conviction, not automatic penalties.
  • PERKESO has announced an enforcement grace period of up to 2 years for small and micro businesses, focused on education and gradual compliance.
The guide says notification is expected to go through MYFutureJobs. Follow PERKESO's announcements for the official start date and process.

What Employers Can Do Now

Use this checklist to prepare before the rules and processes change.

  • 1. Update your exit process: Record each employee's job loss date and remind them to apply for EIS within 60 days.
  • 2. Prepare confirmation documents: Keep offer letter and start-of-work confirmation templates ready.
  • 3. Register on MYFutureJobs: Familiarise your team with the platform.
  • 4. Track vacancies: Keep records of when positions open and are filled.
  • 5. Follow PERKESO announcements: Watch for the vacancy notification start date and process details.
Being prepared can help employees access eligible benefits smoothly and help the company avoid missed notifications.
